title: Completing a Safe Left Pass: Return Right Only When BOTH Headlights of Passed Car Appear in Inside Mirror & >=200 Ft From Oncoming!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: Blue sedan ahead and viewpoint car face forward in same direction; black oncoming truck is in separate opposite lane left of yellow line, not same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Interior shows left-hand drive: driver and steering wheel on left side of cabin.

single_bulb_signal.note: No traffic signal present in scene, only vehicle turn indicators.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Broken yellow centerline on left of travel lanes, white edge line/guardrail on right; left-hand drive, oncoming traffic kept left.

zero_text.note: All plates, screens, and controls are blank shapes; no letters, numbers, or words visible.

scene_match.note: Interior POV shows right signal active and interior rearview mirror clearly displaying both headlights of white car behind with distant oncoming traffic, matching safe-return-after-pass concept.

result.summary: Interior view correctly depicts signaling right to return after confirming both headlights in rearview with clear oncoming distance; all applicable visual rules pass.

teaching_correct.note: Learner sees correct cue: both headlights visible in inside mirror, right signal on, and clear distance from oncoming before returning right.

result.what_i_see: From the left-seat driver interior at sunset, the car signals right behind a blue sedan also signaling right, while the interior rearview mirror shows both headlights of a white car behind with distant oncoming traffic on the left.
